text: Completed numerical-baseline recovery. Core repair commit f0c9f5c; independent review/metafor/comparator commit dc2b2ba4200896c1a5a6b1f7a2b19d1c11364227; clean-SHA receipt commit 816346b. Exact clean worktree at dc2b2ba passed group 69 JVM/68 JS, fit-estimates 11 JVM/8 JS, fmri-workflow 23 JVM/19 JS, reproducible metafor fixture check, and warning-clean scalafimCompileAll. Metafor 5.0.1 parity covers FE, DL, PM, z and ad-hoc mKH across three designs including every covariance entry. The initial PM mismatch was traced to metafor's loose default uniroot tolerance and retained in the receipt; control tol 1e-10 matches ScalaFIM's tighter root. Exact parent 925da6d comparison shows no material OLS gain, but FE median wall/CPU/allocation reductions of 23.29/23.31/37.74 percent and DL reductions of 28.13/28.79/45.05 percent with roundoff-equivalent checksums. No new inference default or calibration claim. Uncertainty provenance, first-level calibration, nuisance admission, and spatial inference remain separate open work.
